notes.title: JURASSIC LAND is now RELEASED !
notes.content:
[h2]We are glad to announce the release of the third world "[b]Jurassic Land[/b]".[/h2]

You can now enjoy the different activities and experiences as in the previous worlds, but now with [b]dinosaurs[/b]. This land comes with new activities and new themes:
You can discover and interact with large set of creatures types in their routine: eating, walking, hunting, etc.
[list]
[*] It focuses on the life aspects of dinosaurs rather than the environment itself.
[*] The racing experience comes this time with a different approach: It's breathcut [b]SURVIVING[/b] experience where you should reach the gathering point before you die.
[*] And many more..
[/list]

We also added many improvements to the user experience. You can now choose the [b]full experience or replaying[/b] any sub activity.

We are working hard to update with new lands and new experiences. So your [b]feedback and suggestions[/b] are always welcome.
